source: 694 A “Deal”
target: 694: Pactum

source: The Dream Festival came to an abrupt end?
target: Festa Somniorum subito finem habuit?

source: Lumian jolted upright, realizing he was holding the strange golden mask he had received from Hisoka.
target: Lumian subito exsurrexit, animadvertens se tenere larvam auream insolitam a Hisoka receptam.

source: For a moment, he couldn’t tell if he was still dreaming or if the mask had somehow followed him from the dream into the waking world.
target: Per momentum, nesciebat utrum adhuc in somnio esset aut num larva, quaedam ratione, eum ex somnio in mundum vigilum secuta esset.

source: Lumian turned to look behind him.
target: Lumian se vertit ut post se aspiceret.

source: Reaza and Maslow, who had died during the Dream Festival, were lying in the middle of the street, just starting to regain consciousness.
target: Reaza et Maslow, qui in Festa Somniorum mortui fuerant, in media via iacebant, modo conscientiam recipientes.

source: Taking advantage of the moment while they gathered their wits and slowly got to their feet, Lumian focused his attention on their luck.
target: Ut tempore, dum mens suas redintegrabant et paulatim surrexerunt, Lumian in eorum fortunam se concentravit.

source: He could see clear signs of death on both of them.
target: Clara signa mortis in utrisque videre poterat.

source: Their fates were about to undergo a rapid transformation, irreversibly tainted by darkness.
target: Fata eorum celeriter se mutura erant, tenebris irreversibiliter contaminata.

source: Reaza’s luck, in particular, was changing even more swiftly and dramatically, like a river suddenly plunging over a cliff to form a waterfall.
target: Fortuna Reazae, praecipue, celerius et fulminanter mutabatur, sicut flumen repente super rupem in cataractam decidens.

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: At that instant, Reaza remembered what had happened to him during the Dream Festival.
target: Illo momento, Reaza recordatus est quid ei in Festa Somniorum evenisset.

source: Uncontrollable fear washed over his pale, cold face.
target: Metus incontrollabilis super faciem eius pallidam et frigida diffusus est.

source: Pop, pop, pop. Huge, mucus-oozing warts erupted all over his body, just as Lumian had witnessed in the dream.
target: Pop, pop, pop. Ingens verrucae, mucum effluentes, per totum corpus eius erupere coeperunt, sicut Lumian in somnio vidit.

source: Seeing Reaza’s eyes turn frenzied and his body start to disintegrate, Lumian raised his free right hand, pointing it at Reaza’s mouth as if it were a gun.
target: Videns oculos Reazae in insaniam versa et corpus eius dissolvi coepisse, Lumian dextram manum liberam levavit, eam in os Reazae, quasi telum, dirigens.

source: A condensed bullet of blazing white flame shot from Lumian’s fingertip, shattering Reaza’s teeth as it entered his mouth.
target: Globus condensatus flammae albae ardentis, a digito Lumiani emissus, dentes Reazae confrinxit, dum in os eius intravit.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: Reaza’s head split apart inch by inch, engulfed in roaring flames.
target: Caput Reazae gradatim dissectum est, flammis rugientibus involutum.

source: The vice-captain of Port Pylos’s patrol team collapsed heavily, his body covered in a thin black suit made up of countless slimy warts.
target: Subpraefectus turmae circuitus Portus Pylos graviter cecidit, corpus eius tenuo nigro vestimento constitutum ex innumeris verrucis mucosis.

source: Lumian turned to Maslow, who was shocked by Reaza’s grotesque transformation and terrified by the death he had experienced in the dream. Calmly, Lumian asked, “Who was he working for?”
target: Lumian se convertit ad Maslow, qui ab transformatione repulsiva Reazae et morte in somnio experta territus erat. Tranquillime, Lumian rogavit: “Pro quo ille operabatur?”

source: As he spoke, Lumian tucked the golden mask into his Traveler’s Bag and checked to make sure the Symphony of Hatred and his other belongings were still there.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian larvam auream in sacco Viatoris recondidit et comprobat ut “Symphonia Odii” atque cetera supellectilia eius adhuc essent.

source: Everything was accounted for, including the food he had thrown at Ludwig.
target: Omnia enumerata erant, etiam cibus quem in Ludwig coniecerat.

source: Maslow paused for a few seconds before answering, “We’re all part of the Numinous Episcopate.”
target: Maslow paucos secundos cessavit antequam respondit: “Omnes sumus pars Episcopatus Numinosi.”

source: Numinous Episcopate… Lumian chuckled. “Do you still believe in Death?”
target: Episcopatus Numinosus… Lumian subridens dixit: “Num adhuc credis in Mortem?”

source: Wasn’t Death already dead?
target: Nonne Mors iam mortua erat?

source: Maslow considered the question for a moment before saying, “Reaza told me that Death is on the verge of returning. There have been signs recently that prayers are being answered again.”
target: Maslow quaestionem per momentum meditatus, dixerat: “Reaza mihi narravit Mortem rediturum esse. Nuper signa apparuerunt, ut orationes iterum responderentur.”

source: Hearing Maslow’s words, Lumian nodded pensively.
target: Audito Maslovi sermone, Lumian pensuose annuit.

source: “Which faction of the Numinous Episcopate do you belong to?”
target: “Ad quam factionem Episcopatus Numinosi pertines?”

source: As far as he knew, the Numinous Episcopate was divided into numerous factions. There were the Royals, led by the descendants of the Eggers family, who sought to restore the Balam Empire’s rule; the Artificial Death faction, which had somehow recreated Death itself; and the less influential Repose and Underworld factions.
target: Quoad notitiam eius, Episcopatus Numinosus in plurimas factiones divisus erat. Erant regales, ab posteris familiae Eggers ducti, qui imperium Balam restaurare studebant; factio Mortis Artificiali, quae Mortem ipsum aliquo modo recreaverat; atque factio Requies et Inferorum, minus influae.

source: “We’re from the Royal faction,” Maslow admitted.
target: “Nos ex factione Regali sumus,” Maslow agnovit.

source: “Did you infiltrate the patrol team on purpose?” Lumian asked nonchalantly.
target: “Num penitus in turmam circuitus insidiis intravisti?” Lumian nonchalanter interrogavit.

source: Maslow shook his head.
target: Maslow caput negavit.

source: “No, Admiral Querarill has been secretly working with us.”
target: “Non, Admiral Querarill occulte nobiscum operatus est.”

source: Admiral Querarill, the de facto ruler of Matani, is closely tied to the Numinous Episcopate’s Royal faction… Combined with the Church of Earth Mother and the remaining Intis faction, this must be what Franca meant by dancing on three eggs. Judging by the situation, Reaza wasn’t a traitor after all… It’s no wonder Admiral Querarill didn’t send backup. If the Numinous Episcopate and the Church of The Fool can’t handle the problem, it won’t matter how many people he sends…
target: Admiral Querarill, qui re vera Matani rector est, arcte coniunctus est cum factione Regali Episcopatus Numinosi… Cum Ecclesia Mater Terrae et reliqua factione Intis coniunctus, id oportet fuisse quod Franca de tribus ovellis saltando significavit. Ex conditione iudicata, Reaza non fuit proditor. Non mirum est quod Admiral Querarill subsidia non misit. Si Episcopatus Numinosus et Ecclesia Stulti problema superare non possunt, non refert quot homines mittat.

source: His mind now clear, Lumian asked, “Was participating in this Dream Festival a direct order from the Royal faction’s upper ranks?”
target: Mens eius iam clarus, Lumian rogavit: “Num participatio in hoc Festa Somniorum iussu directo ab superiores factionis Regalis facta est?”

source: “Yes.” Maslow glanced at Reaza’s body, now unrecognizable as human, and said, “Apparently the order came straight from the Empress.”
target: “Ita,” Maslow, oculos in corpus Reazae detorsos, quae iam humanum agnoscere non poterant, dixit: “Apparet quod ius directe a Imperatrice ortus sit.”

source: Empress… The Pale Empress of the Numinous Episcopate’s Royal faction? Lumian instinctively scanned his surroundings.
target: Imperatrix… Imperatrix Pallida factionis Regalis Episcopatus Numinosi? Lumian instinctive circumspiciebat.

source: A sudden thought struck him. He drew the straight sword he had bought in Port Santa, picked up Reaza’s clothes, and quickly searched through the items he had left behind.
target: Subita cogitatio eum percusit. Extraxit gladium rectum, quem in Porto Santa emi, vestimenta Reazae colligens, celeriter per reliquas res quae relicta erant quaesivit.

source: There was no sign of the death-corroded golden mask or the crystal-like skull.
target: Nullum signum larvae aureae, mortis corrumpentis, aut cranii sicut crystallum apparuit.

source: Even though the skull had turned into a goat in the dream and the golden mask had sunk into the tranquil river, Lumian reasoned that it had still been a dream, after all. No matter how unusual it was, it was ultimately just a dream. When someone died, they died in reality, but the same might not hold true for objects.
target: Etiamsi cranium in somnio in capram conversum fuerat et larva aurea in flumen tranquillum demergita, Lumian putavit tamen id somnium esse; quamquam mirum, tandem solum somnium erat. Cum quis moritur, vere perit; sed talia obiectis fortasse non conveniunt.

source: It was similar to how some of the food Ludwig had eaten in the dream had reappeared in the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Simile erat quo cibus, quem Ludwig in somnio comederat, in sacco Viatoris iterum apparuerit.

source: Even if the items were going to disappear, it would have to happen later. For now, they should definitely return to the real world!
target: Etiamsi illa evanescere destinata erant, hoc postea fieri oportebat; nunc certe ad mundum reale redeuntem esse debebant!

source: However, Reaza had nothing on him.
target: Tamen, Reaza nihil ei adversum habebat.

source: A chill ran down Lumian’s spine. Lowering his voice, he asked, “Termiboros, did you notice anything?”
target: Gelidus tremor per dorsum Lumiani transiit. Vocem deminuens, rogavit: “Termiboros, quidquam animadvertisti?”

source: Termiboros’s majestic voice echoed in Lumian’s ears. “Do you only now know fear?”
target: Voce regia Termibori in auribus Lumiani resonabat: “Num tantum nunc timorem cognoscis?”

source: “Tch.” Lumian felt a lingering sense of dread, but he didn’t let it show. “Was the Pale Empress watching?”
target: “Tch.” Lumian, sensu metuoso manente, sed non ostendens, dixit: “Num Imperatrix Pallida spectabat?”

source: Termiboros replied in a deep tone, “It’s not just Her.”
target: Termiboros, voce profunda, respondit: “Non sola illa est.”

source: Her? The Pale Empress is an Angel? Lumian composed himself and turned his attention back to Maslow.
target: “Illa? Num Imperatrix Pallida angelus sit?” Lumian se composuit et ad Maslow rediit.

source: Just as Maslow was wondering why Louis Berry was talking to himself, the other party suddenly asked, “Why did Reaza kill you?”
target: Dum Maslow mirabatur cur Louis Berry sese solum loqueretur, adversarius repente rogavit: “Cur Reaza te occidit?”

source: Maslow stayed quiet, offering no response.
target: Maslow silentium servavit, nullam responsionem dabat.

source: Lumian chuckled. “Did you betray him?”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Illum prodidistine?”

source: Maslow’s lips trembled, but he didn’t say a word.
target: Labia Maslovi tremuerunt, sed nihil dixit.

source: Lumian smiled casually and said, “It doesn’t matter. If you don’t want to answer, don’t. You won’t be alive much longer anyway.”
target: Lumian leniter risit et dixit: “Non refert. Si respondere nolo, ne respondeas. Nihil diu vita tibi manebit.”

source: Maslow’s face turned ashen as he considered the ramifications of his death during the Dream Festival.
target: Facies Maslovi cinerea facta est, dum de consequentiis mortis in Festa Somniorum meditaret.

source: Lumian nodded, then added, “Go on and do whatever you want. Just don’t do anything bad. It’ll make you die sooner.”
target: Lumian annuit, deinde addidit: “Procede atque fac quaecumque velis. Tantum ne agas quid malum; id te velocius interficiet.”

source: With that, Lumian glanced at Reaza’s corpse, which was starting to produce the Beyonder characteristic. Greed welled up inside him, but he suppressed it with an Ascetic’s self-control.
target: His verbis, Lumian respectus est ad cadaver Reazae, quod notam Beyonder exhibere coepit. Avaritia intus eum surgebat, sed eam moderatione ascetica reprimi curavit.

source: He decided that regardless of whether Reaza had been a traitor or not, his Beyonder characteristics should be left for Camus and the Matani patrol team.
target: Statuit quod, sive Reaza proditor fuerit sive non, proprietates eius Beyonder Camus et turmae Matani relinquendae essent.

source: To stop himself from giving in to greed and with a grave matter coming to mind, Lumian’s expression shifted subtly. He activated the black mark on his right shoulder and teleported away.
target: Ut se a cupiditate non deduceret et cum res gravi mente oriri inciperet, vultus Lumiani leviter mutatus est. Maculam nigram in umero dextro activavit atque se teleportavit.

source: Maslow stared at the street that had been empty a moment before and the lights that had been stirred by the explosion, looking as though his soul had left his body. With a dazed and despondent expression, he turned and walked toward the forest outside Tizamo.
target: Maslow spectabat viam, quae paulo ante vacua erat, et lumina, quae explosione excitata erant, quasi anima eius ex corpore discessisset. Stupefactus et maerens, se convertit et in silvam extra Tizamo processit.

source: In the second-floor suite of the Brieu Motel.
target: In conclavi secundae plantae Brieu Motel.

source: The instant Lugano woke up, he noticed he couldn’t move his right forearm.
target: Statim quo Lugano evigilavit, animadvertit se antebrachium dextro movere non posse.

source: It’s okay, it’s okay. I’ll be fine after a psychiatric treatment or two. The people in Tizamo can be healed by Mass without needing Beyonder effects… Lugano tried to console himself as he endured the pain in his right forearm.
target: Est in ordine, est in ordine. Post unam vel duas therapias psychiatrics, bene ero. Homines in Tizamo per Missam sanari possunt, sine auxilio effectuum Beyonder. Lugano se consolari conatus est, dolorem in antebrachio dextro ferens.

source: Just then, he heard hurried footsteps coming from the living room outside his door.
target: Tum, audivit vestigia pedum festinantia e conclavi extra ianuam eius venire.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: The door to Lugano’s bedroom flew open. In the crimson moonlight pouring through the window, Ludwig appeared, dressed in blue pajamas with yellow stars and a matching nightcap. He was clutching a half-withered, blood-stained, dark red heart.
target: Ianuam cubiculi Lugani celeriter patefecit. In lumine lunari coccineo per fenestram effluente, Ludwig apparuit, indutus in caeruleis pyjama cum stellis flavescentibus et pileo congruenti. Manus tenebat cor dimidiatum, rubrum obscurum, sanguine maculatum.

source: Badump! Badump!
target: Badump! Badump!

source: Lugano could hear his own heart pounding, and he felt like his soul was about to abandon his body out of sheer terror.
target: Lugano audire poterat proprium cor pulsantem, et sentiebat quasi anima eius ex corpore timore puro discedere velle.

source: Had Ludwig come back for seconds because he had woken up early and hadn’t gotten his fill during the dream?
target: An Ludwig redierat pro secunda, quia mane evigilaverat et in somnio non se satiaverat?

source: A moment later, Lugano saw a figure float in through the doorway.
target: Paululum post, Lugano vidit figuram per ianuam leviter fluitantem.

source: The figure was semi-transparent, wearing an elaborate, opulent, black dress. There was no head on its neck, just a clean cut. In its hand, it held four identical blonde heads with red eyes and beautiful features.
target: Figura semitransparens erat, induta veste nigra intricata et opulenta. In collo non erat caput, sed solum excisio purus. In manu, quattuor capita flavida, identica, cum oculis rubris et lineamentis venustis, tenebat.

source: “Return…” “It”… “To”… “Me”…
target: “Rede…” “Id…” “Ad…” “Me…”

source: The four heads uttered different words in ancient Feysac, forming a complete sentence.
target: Quattuor capita verba diversa in antiqua Feysac efferuerunt, formantes sententiam completam.

source: Ludwig’s image was reflected in their eight crimson eyes.
target: Imago Ludvigi in eorum octo oculis coccineis reflexa est.

source: “Mine!” Ludwig ran to Lugano’s bed and spun around, looking like he wanted to bring the heart to his mouth, but he seemed to hesitate.
target: “Meum!” Ludwig ad lectum Lugani cucurrit et gyravit, videns quasi cor ad os ferre velle, sed haesitabat.

source: The four heads held by the translucent figure spoke one by one, “Idiot”… “Eating”… “Your”… “Own”… “Brain”…
target: Quattuor capita a figura translucida tenuta singillatim dixerunt: “Stulte”… “Manducans”… “Tuum”… “Proprium”… “Cerebrum”…

source: “That” “Is” “My” “Heart”
target: “Id” “Est” “Meum” “Cor”

source: “If” “You” “Don’t” “Return”
target: “Si” “Tu” “Non” “Redieris”

source: “I” “Will” “Turn” “You” “Into” “Pig”
target: “Ego” “Te” “Vertebo” “In” “Porcum”

source: Almost at the same moment, Lumian materialized next to Ludwig, taking in the scene and hearing the corresponding words.
target: Paululum simul, Lumian iuxta Ludwig apparuit, scaenam contemplans et verba congruenta audiens.

source: Lumian glanced at the strange-looking lady, then at Ludwig, who wore a resolute expression as if he would defend his food to the death. After a moment’s consideration, Lumian said,
target: Lumian aspiciens ad mulierem insolitae species, deinde ad Ludvigum, qui vultum constanter gerebat, quasi cibum suum ad mortem defendere velle, parvo tempore meditatus, Lumian dixit:

source: “Madam, perhaps you could try trading him other spiritually rich materials for it.”
target: “Domina, forsitan conari potestis eum aliis materiis spiritualiter dives pro eo commutare.”

source: In Ludwig’s current state, Lumian didn’t dare try to take the item from him by force.
target: In statu Ludvigi hodierno, Lumian non ausus est cor vi eripere.

source: The lady in the intricate black dress, holding four blonde, red-eyed heads, went silent.
target: Mulier in intricata veste nigra, quae quattuor capita flavida cum oculis rubris tenebat, silentium cepit.

source: After a short while, one of her heads spat out a gleaming gold coin and held it between its teeth.
target: Paulo post, una ex capitibus eius nummum aureum nitentem exspuat et inter dentes retinuit.

source: A gold coin? You want to buy it with a gold coin? Ludwig doesn’t care about money… Lumian was about to point this out to the lady when he suddenly realized the gold coin looked familiar.
target: Nummus aureus? Visne id emere nummo aureo? Ludwig pecuniae non curat… Lumian id mulieri indicare paratus erat, cum subito animadvertit nummum aureum familiarem esse videbatur.

source: It was a Loen gold coin, worth 1 pound.
target: Erat nummus aureus Loenensis, unius librae valoris.

source: Uh… Lumian glanced over at Ludwig.
target: Uh… Lumian ad Ludwig aspexit.

source: Ludwig wavered.
target: Ludwig titubavit.

source: After a few seconds, he finally held out his hands and gave the half-withered dark red heart to the woman’s head.
target: Post paucos secundos, tandem manus protulit et cor dimidiatum, rubrum obscurum, capiti mulieris tradidit.

source: The blonde, red-eyed head let go, dropping the gold coin into Ludwig’s hand. Quickly, it sank its teeth into the half-withered dark red heart.
target: Caput flavum, cum oculis rubris, dimisit, nummum aureum in manum Ludvigi deiecit; celeriter dentes in cor dimidiatum, rubrum obscurum infodit.

source: The translucent lady stepped back and vanished from Lugano’s bedroom.
target: Mulier translucida retrorsum processit atque ex cubiculi Lugani evanuit.

source: Ludwig hastily popped the Loen gold coin into his mouth, as if trying to hide it in his stomach. But then he seemed to think better of it and fished it back out. He wiped it off on his pajamas and carefully put it in his pocket.
target: Ludwig festinanter nummum aureum Loenensem in os suum coniecit, quasi eum in ventre celare conaretur; sed deinde melius sentire videbatur et eum iterum extraxit. Illud in pyjama lavit et caute in sinum suum recondidit.

source: Just as I thought, it’s the same as Jenna’s lucky gold coin… A Loen gold coin closely connected to Mr. Fool? Lumian nodded to himself, comprehension dawning.
target: Ut putavi, id est idem ac nummus aureus felix Jennae… Nummus aureus Loenensis, ad Dominum Stultum arcte coniunctus? Lumian sibi annuit, intellectus emergens.

source: A twinge of disappointment ran through him.
target: Modicus tristitiae impetus per eum pervenit.

source: Two people close to me have gotten lucky gold coins. Why don’t I have one?
target: Duo homines mihi proximos nummos aureos fortunatos acceperunt. Cur ego unum non habeo?
